captures.label: Camp overhead
notes: Nine red tents form a regular three-by-three layout with broad, even clear gaps and a continuous dirt-path interior.
Four crop quadrants turn cleanly around the central area; broad roads separate the large outer pens.
No stray tent-corner crop islands are visible. Far fog limits inspection of the complete outer wall.

captures.label: Main gate
notes: A broad, unobstructed dirt-path entrance runs between log posts beneath the horizontal lintel; the skull faces outward.
Grass and plants remain beside the path at the inner wall edge. No obstructing center ridge or missing approach lane is visible.
Exact eight-block road width is covered by artifact checks rather than estimated from perspective.

captures.label: Tent interior
notes: The red-wool tent retains beds, hay floor, chests, cushions, a central campfire and orcs in a coherent interior.
Smoke obscures part of the center and rear; this view does not establish the complete furniture count or twelve-block footprint.

captures.label: Palisade and shared pen edge
notes: The close palisade has regularly spaced log posts, continuous acacia panels and the intended ornaments.
A green strip with plants remains along its inside before the road; the adjoining pen has ample space around its pond, hay and livestock.
No visible clipped wall or irregular open gap was found; exact six-clear-block post spacing is separately checked.

captures.label: Crop corner
notes: Crop bands, including the tall outer band, make continuous L-shaped turns with broad paths along both legs.
The adjacent tent corner is clear and pathed; visible pumpkins have no torches on top.
Dense crops partly conceal individual pumpkin stems, so the precise pumpkin-stem-stem-pumpkin sequence relies on block-level checks.

captures.label: Mushroom patch
notes: Mixed red and brown mushrooms visibly sit on a distinct podzol patch beside the path and crop rows.
No grass replacement or pumpkin-mounted torch is visible in this close view. Other mushroom patches are outside the frame.

captures.label: Livestock pens
notes: Large pens contain livestock, square ponds, hay and retained ground vegetation; roads between pens are broad and unobstructed.
Visible centered gate runs are continuous and broad, with no missing fence sections.
The frame cannot expose all four sides of every pen; twenty-four-block interiors and four-wide gates on each side are separately checked.

captures.label: Twelve crop rows and cane ponds
notes: The close crop belt shows multiple continuous crop rows, regularly spaced pumpkins without torches, and contained blue irrigation ponds surrounded by tall cane.
The foreground road and central dirt-path area are continuous; enlarged tents remain evenly spaced with clear corners.
Podzol and mixed mushrooms are visible at the crop-belt end. Cane emerges above the water, while its submerged root and exact one-block pond depth are hidden and verified by separate artifact checks.

captures.label: mansion-full-third-floor-slab-roof
captures.notes: Complete square roof and three equal-height facade tiers are visible, without roof gaps, missing chunks or floating caps. Ground-floor windows repeat the upper-floor window pattern. The solid plank backing beneath each slab is covered by native block assertions, not directly visible here.

captures.label: mansion-main-entry
captures.notes: Main cobblestone stair is clear at the ground-floor approach; shorter foyer, floor/carpet boundary, adjacent plank torch posts and log cross are visible. Full route connectivity is established by the native walking test.

captures.label: mansion-foyer-eight-block-floor-connection
captures.notes: Upper foyer landing connects flush into the carpeted hall. No added three-step birch rise or raised carpet corner post is visible. Oak-plank torch columns and white carpet borders are clear.

captures.label: mansion-upper-stair-hall
captures.notes: Replacement side camera clearly shows the continuous cobblestone flight reaching a flat birch landing and the carpeted upper hallway, with no raised birch spacer steps or blocking face panel. This replaces the occluded first camera; native navigation and headroom checks also passed.

captures.label: mansion-oak-posts-and-carpet-corners
captures.notes: Repeated torch-bearing columns are visibly oak planks, with red hallway carpet and white borders at corridor intersections. Illagers partly overlap the distant floor, but nearby border geometry is unobstructed.

captures.label: mansion-cellar-behind-main-stairs
captures.notes: Three-wide stone-brick descent, dry landing and single iron door are visible. Wall-torch tips are visible. The upper camera angle hides most of the ceiling and exterior lanterns, so this frame alone does not establish exact ceiling height or both lantern positions.

captures.label: mansion-revised-cellar
captures.notes: Dry, continuous central hall with repeated paired room entrances and three inward lantern rows. No spill, floating light or blocked floor is visible. The full twenty-room map and crop pairing require the layout assertions rather than this single hall view.

captures.label: mansion-authored-crops
captures.notes: Carrot room is inside the outer mushroom room, with a connecting opening, contained irrigation, inward corner lanterns and central lantern. Crop rows and the visible mushroom plot remain intact.

captures.label: mansion-authored-pens
captures.notes: Pig pen has grass between the hay banks, retained water trough, side gates and inward lanterns. Stone under occupied hay is hidden by hay and is established by block assertions.

captures.label: mansion-four-lowered-chandeliers
captures.notes: Lowered fence-and-torch chandeliers render above preserved tables, white table coverings and flower pots. The near fixture and two rear fixtures are clear; the near fixture partly hides the fourth, so the image establishes appearance and clearance but not the exact four-fixture count by itself.

captures.label: desert-straight-sand-entrance-0
captures.notes: Pass: a straight, dry opening cuts through the sand/red-sand terrace edge. Adjacent original terrace surfaces and the rim remain sandy; exposed stone and mineral patches are confined to the cut opening. No visible water breach or obstructed entrance. The camera clearly frames the complete mouth.

captures.label: desert-straight-sand-entrance-1
captures.notes: Pass: the paired entrance likewise has a straight approach and intact sandy sides on the opposite exported terrace bank. No stone coating extends across the uncut surrounding sand or red-sand terrace, and no visible lake breach. The camera clearly frames the mouth and approach.

captures.label: desert-curved-descent-near-t-zero
captures.notes: Pass: the interior view shows a continuous descending stone floor, ample headroom, and a gentle turn toward the lower passage. The central walking route is open; sparse mushrooms remain off its center. No visible wall gap, water intrusion, or blocked descent. One frame cannot establish the complete route or its T-gradient relationship; those are covered by the passing native tests.

captures.label: restored-tropical-coast
captures.notes: Restored dense rainforest canopy, tall jungle trees and the outer woodland/ground vegetation render without visible gaps or missing textures. The frame looks inland and fog limits the whole-island outline; exact restored bands are independently covered by archived-equivalence and native biome tests.

captures.label: cherry-final-bamboo
captures.notes: Healthy bamboo renders among restored pink cherry trees and flowers. The close view demonstrates the cherry habitat and bamboo under the canopy; branches hide other stems and the full patch boundary, so the ten-stem/six-by-six count and clearance rules rely on the passing native tests.
